title: decision: atomic enqueue (.msg then .env rename) is sound for durable queue
description: queue.rs and relay_queue.rs both write .msg via tmp-then-rename, then write .env via tmp-then-rename. The drain loop treats presence of .env as the signal that an entry is complete. This means a crash between the two renames leaves only an orphaned .msg with no .env, which is ignored by drain and is cleaned up by cleanup_orphan_msg_files. The invariant is sound. (A separate P0 issue covers the race window where drain reads .msg before .env rename completes.)
